request.prompt:
Job X2: usp_large_loss_watchlist. Claims with incurred of at least EUR 25,000 as at the as-of date, with 90-day movement, reserve activity and a watch category for the claims committee
Parameters: AsOfDate=2025-12-31.

Code:
  1 | /*==============================================================================
  2 |   Job      : rpt.usp_large_loss_watchlist
  3 |   Purpose  : Large-loss watchlist for the claims committee. Every claim with an
  4 |              incurred amount (paid to date plus outstanding case reserve) of at
  5 |              least EUR 25,000 as at @AsOfDate, compared with 90 days earlier and
  6 |              given a watch category (NEW, DETERIORATING, IMPROVING, STABLE).
  7 |   Author   : RBy
  8 |   Change log
  9 |     2013-05-22  RBy   Initial version (CR-0301)
 10 |     2015-01-19  RBy   Expense reserves included in incurred (CR-0577)
 11 |     2016-10-04  DMcC  Claims closed more than 90 days ago dropped (CR-0912)
 12 |     2018-07-30  DMcC  Reserve changes and days since last activity added (CR-1188)
 13 |     2020-02-11  NOF   Threshold raised from EUR 20,000 to EUR 25,000 (CR-1402)
 14 |     2022-09-05  NOF   Status and LOB codes trimmed and upper-cased (INC-3204)
 15 | ==============================================================================*/
 16 | SET NOCOUNT ON;
 17 | GO
 18 | IF OBJECT_ID(N'rpt.large_loss_watchlist', N'U') IS NULL
 19 | CREATE TABLE rpt.large_loss_watchlist (
 20 |     as_of_date                DATE           NOT NULL,
 21 |     claim_id                  INT            NOT NULL,
 22 |     claim_number              VARCHAR(20)    NOT NULL,
 23 |     policy_id                 INT            NOT NULL,
 24 |     lob_code                  VARCHAR(5)     NOT NULL,
 25 |     claim_status              VARCHAR(12)    NOT NULL,
 26 |     reported_date             DATE           NOT NULL,
 27 |     closed_date               DATE           NULL,
 28 |     paid_to_date              DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 29 |     outstanding_reserve       DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 30 |     incurred_amount           DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 31 |     incurred_90d_ago          DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 32 |     movement_90d              DECIMAL(14,2)  NOT NULL,
 33 |     reserve_changes_90d       INT            NOT NULL,
 34 |     days_since_last_activity  INT            NULL,
 35 |     watch_category            VARCHAR(15)    NOT NULL
 36 | );
 37 | GO
 38 | CREATE OR ALTER PROCEDURE rpt.usp_large_loss_watchlist
 39 |     @AsOfDate DATE
 40 | AS
 41 | BEGIN
 42 |     SET NOCOUNT ON;
 43 | 
 44 |     DECLARE @job       VARCHAR(128) = 'rpt.usp_large_loss_watchlist';
 45 |     DECLARE @PriorDate DATE         = DATEADD(DAY, -90, @AsOfDate);
 46 |     DECLARE @rows      INT;
 47 | 
 48 |     BEGIN TRY
 49 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job, @step_name = 'start', @status = 'STARTED';
 50 | 
 51 |         -- open and reopened claims, plus claims closed in the last 90 days
 52 |         SELECT c.claim_id, c.claim_number, c.policy_id,
 53 |                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.lob_code))) AS lob_code,
 54 |                UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.status)))   AS claim_status,
 55 |                c.reported_date, c.closed_date
 56 |         INTO #clm
 57 |         FROM stg.claims c WITH (NOLOCK)
 58 |         WHERE c.reported_date <= @AsOfDate
 59 |           AND (c.status <> 'CLOSED' OR c.closed_date > @PriorDate);
 60 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
 61 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job, @step_name = 'claims', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
 62 | 
 63 |         -- payments to date and 90 days ago; unkeyed amounts count as nil
 64 |         SELECT p.claim_id,
 65 |                SUM(ISNULL(p.amount, 0)) AS paid_now,
 66 |                SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= @PriorDate THEN ISNULL(p.amount, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS paid_prior,
 67 |                MAX(CASE WHEN p.amount IS NOT NULL THEN p.payment_date END) AS last_payment_date
 68 |         INTO #paid
 69 |         FROM stg.claim_payments p WITH (NOLOCK)
 70 |         INNER JOIN #clm c ON c.claim_id = p.claim_id
 71 |         WHERE p.payment_date <= @AsOfDate
 72 |         GROUP BY p.claim_id;
 73 | 
 74 |         -- outstanding reserve as at today and 90 days ago
 75 |         SELECT r.claim_id, d.period, r.reserve_amount,
 76 |                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.period, r.claim_id
 77 |                                   ORDER BY r.reserve_date DESC, r.reserve_id DESC) AS rn
 78 |         INTO #res
 79 |         FROM stg.claim_reserves r WITH (NOLOCK)
 80 |         INNER JOIN #clm c ON c.claim_id = r.claim_id
 81 |         CROSS APPLY (VALUES ('NOW', @AsOfDate), ('PRIOR', @PriorDate)) d (period, as_at)
 82 |         WHERE r.reserve_date <= d.as_at;
 83 | 
 84 |         SELECT claim_id,
 85 |                SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'NOW'   THEN reserve_amount ELSE 0 END) AS os_now,
 86 |                SUM(CASE WHEN period = 'PRIOR' THEN reserve_amount ELSE 0 END) AS os_prior
 87 |         INTO #os
 88 |         FROM #res
 89 |         WHERE rn = 1
 90 |         GROUP BY claim_id;
 91 | 
 92 |         -- reserve activity
 93 |         SELECT r.claim_id,
 94 |                SUM(CASE WHEN r.reserve_date > @PriorDate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS reserve_changes_90d,
 95 |                MAX(r.reserve_date) AS last_reserve_date
 96 |         INTO #ract
 97 |         FROM stg.claim_reserves r WITH (NOLOCK)
 98 |         INNER JOIN #clm c ON c.claim_id = r.claim_id
 99 |         WHERE r.reserve_date <= @AsOfDate
100 |         GROUP BY r.claim_id;
101 | 
102 |         SELECT c.claim_id,
103 |                ISNULL(p.paid_now, 0) AS paid_to_date,
104 |                ISNULL(o.os_now, 0) AS outstanding_reserve,
105 |                ISNULL(p.paid_now, 0) + ISNULL(o.os_now, 0) AS incurred_amount,
106 |                ISNULL(p.paid_prior, 0) + ISNULL(o.os_prior, 0) AS incurred_90d_ago,
107 |                ISNULL(a.reserve_changes_90d, 0) AS reserve_changes_90d,
108 |                CASE WHEN ISNULL(p.last_payment_date, '19000101') > ISNULL(a.last_reserve_date, '19000101')
109 |                     THEN p.last_payment_date ELSE a.last_reserve_date END AS last_activity_date
110 |         INTO #inc
111 |         FROM #clm c
112 |         LEFT JOIN #paid p ON p.claim_id = c.claim_id
113 |         LEFT JOIN #os o   ON o.claim_id = c.claim_id
114 |         LEFT JOIN #ract a ON a.claim_id = c.claim_id;
115 | 
116 |         TRUNCATE TABLE rpt.large_loss_watchlist;
117 | 
118 |         INSERT INTO rpt.large_loss_watchlist
119 |             (as_of_date, claim_id, claim_number, policy_id, lob_code, claim_status, reported_date,
120 |              closed_date, paid_to_date, outstanding_reserve, incurred_amount, incurred_90d_ago,
121 |              movement_90d, reserve_changes_90d, days_since_last_activity, watch_category)
122 |         SELECT @AsOfDate, c.claim_id, c.claim_number, c.policy_id, c.lob_code, c.claim_status,
123 |                c.reported_date, c.closed_date,
124 |                i.paid_to_date, i.outstanding_reserve, i.incurred_amount, i.incurred_90d_ago,
125 |                i.incurred_amount - i.incurred_90d_ago,
126 |                i.reserve_changes_90d,
127 |                DATEDIFF(DAY, i.last_activity_date, @AsOfDate),
128 |                CASE WHEN i.incurred_90d_ago < 25000 THEN 'NEW'
129 |                     WHEN i.incurred_amount > i.incurred_90d_ago * 1.10 THEN 'DETERIORATING'
130 |                     WHEN i.incurred_amount < i.incurred_90d_ago * 0.90 THEN 'IMPROVING'
131 |                     ELSE 'STABLE' END
132 |         FROM #inc i
133 |         INNER JOIN #clm c ON c.claim_id = i.claim_id
134 |         WHERE i.incurred_amount >= 25000;
135 |         SET @rows = @@ROWCOUNT;
136 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job, @step_name = 'load rpt.large_loss_watchlist', @status = 'INFO', @rows_affected = @rows;
137 | 
138 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'SUCCESS';
139 |     END TRY
140 |     BEGIN CATCH
141 |         DECLARE @msg NVARCHAR(4000) = ERROR_MESSAGE(), @err INT = ERROR_NUMBER();
142 |         EXEC etl.usp_log_step @job_name = @job, @step_name = 'end', @status = 'FAILED',
143 |              @message = @msg, @error_number = @err;
144 |         THROW;
145 |     END CATCH
146 | END;
147 | GO

Views for impact queries:
- stg_claims (stg.claims): claim_id int, claim_number string, policy_id int, customer_id int, lob_code string, loss_date date, reported_date date, status string, closed_date date, cause_code string, handler_code string, description string, _row_seq int
- stg_claim_payments (stg.claim_payments): payment_id int, claim_id int, payment_date date, amount decimal(12,2), payment_type string, payee_type string, _row_seq int
- stg_claim_reserves (stg.claim_reserves): reserve_id int, claim_id int, reserve_date date, reserve_type string, reserve_amount decimal(12,2), _row_seq int
- golden_rpt_large_loss_watchlist (the legacy output rpt.large_loss_watchlist): as_of_date date, claim_id int, claim_number string, policy_id int, lob_code string, claim_status string, reported_date date, closed_date date, paid_to_date decimal(14,2), outstanding_reserve decimal(14,2), incurred_amount decimal(14,2), incurred_90d_ago decimal(14,2), movement_90d decimal(14,2), reserve_changes_90d int, days_since_last_activity int, watch_category string

request.system_prompt:
You are the defect reviewer agent of LANSH, a factory that migrates legacy T-SQL (SQL Server 2022) jobs to PySpark. LANSH reproduces every legacy behaviour exactly, bugs included, and asks a person to decide what to do about each suspected bug, so finding them matters.

Read the job and list the places where the code most likely does not do what its author intended: wrong comparisons or boundaries, joins that multiply rows, gaps or overlaps in bands, wrong date columns, missing values handled wrongly, truncation, hard-coded constants that should vary. Ignore style, performance and things that are merely unusual. For each, write one Spark SQL SELECT over the views listed that measures the impact on the legacy output: it must return exactly one row with rows_affected (the output rows the bug changes) and, when the bug changes an amount, amount_affected (the total change, positive). Compare what the legacy output holds with what the intended logic would give. Use only the views and columns listed.

defects.description: #res numbers the reserve rows with ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY period, claim_id ORDER BY reserve_date DESC, reserve_id DESC) and keeps rn = 1. That leaves one reserve row per claim and period. A claim usually holds an indemnity reserve and an expense reserve (CR-0577). Only the most recently changed of the two goes into outstanding_reserve, and the other type's open reserve is dropped. This understates outstanding_reserve, incurred_amount, incurred_90d_ago and movement_90d. It can also keep claims off the list entirely or give them the wrong watch_category.
defects.impact_query: WITH clm AS (SELECT claim_id FROM stg_claims WHERE reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND (upper(rtrim(status)) <> 'CLOSED' OR closed_date > DATE'2025-10-02')), paid AS (SELECT p.claim_id, SUM(COALESCE(p.amount,0)) AS paid_now, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_date <= DATE'2025-10-02' THEN COALESCE(p.amount,0) ELSE 0 END) AS paid_prior FROM stg_claim_payments p JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = p.claim_id WHERE p.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.claim_id), res AS (SELECT r.claim_id, r.reserve_amount, d.period, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.period, r.claim_id ORDER BY r.reserve_date DESC, r.reserve_id DESC) AS rn_leg, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.period, r.claim_id, r.reserve_type ORDER BY r.reserve_date DESC, r.reserve_id DESC) AS rn_int FROM stg_claim_reserves r JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = r.claim_id CROSS JOIN (SELECT 'NOW' AS period, DATE'2025-12-31' AS as_at UNION ALL SELECT 'PRIOR' AS period, DATE'2025-10-02' AS as_at) d WHERE r.reserve_date <= d.as_at), os AS (SELECT claim_id, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period='NOW' AND rn_leg=1 THEN reserve_amount END),0) AS leg_now, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period='PRIOR' AND rn_leg=1 THEN reserve_amount END),0) AS leg_prior, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period='NOW' AND rn_int=1 THEN reserve_amount END),0) AS int_now, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN period='PRIOR' AND rn_int=1 THEN reserve_amount END),0) AS int_prior FROM res GROUP BY claim_id), cmp AS (SELECT c.claim_id, COALESCE(p.paid_now,0) + COALESCE(o.leg_now,0) AS leg_inc, COALESCE(p.paid_now,0) + COALESCE(o.int_now,0) AS int_inc, COALESCE(p.paid_prior,0) + COALESCE(o.leg_prior,0) AS leg_prior_inc, COALESCE(p.paid_prior,0) + COALESCE(o.int_prior,0) AS int_prior_inc FROM clm c LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.claim_id = c.claim_id LEFT JOIN os o ON o.claim_id = c.claim_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(int_inc - leg_inc)),0) AS amount_affected FROM cmp WHERE (leg_inc >= 25000 OR int_inc >= 25000) AND (leg_inc <> int_inc OR leg_prior_inc <> int_prior_inc)
defects.intended_behaviour: Take the latest reserve for each claim, period and reserve_type (add reserve_type to the PARTITION BY), then add up those latest amounts across types to get the outstanding reserve. This is how expense reserves become part of incurred, as CR-0577 asks.
defects.title: Latest reserve picked across all reserve types, so only one type counts

defects.description: The claim filter keeps closed claims only when closed_date > @PriorDate, where @PriorDate is AsOfDate - 90 days (2025-10-02). A claim closed on 2025-10-02, exactly 90 days before the as-of date, is therefore left out.
defects.impact_query: WITH clm AS (SELECT claim_id FROM stg_claims WHERE reported_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' AND upper(rtrim(status)) = 'CLOSED' AND closed_date = DATE'2025-10-02'), paid AS (SELECT p.claim_id, SUM(COALESCE(p.amount,0)) AS paid_now FROM stg_claim_payments p JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = p.claim_id WHERE p.payment_date <= DATE'2025-12-31' GROUP BY p.claim_id), res AS (SELECT r.claim_id, r.reserve_amount, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY r.claim_id ORDER BY r.reserve_date DESC, r.reserve_id DESC) AS rn FROM stg_claim_reserves r JOIN clm c ON c.claim_id = r.claim_id WHERE r.reserve_date <= DATE'2025-12-31'), os AS (SELECT claim_id, COALESCE(SUM(reserve_amount),0) AS os_now FROM res WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY claim_id), inc AS (SELECT c.claim_id, COALESCE(p.paid_now,0) + COALESCE(o.os_now,0) AS incurred FROM clm c LEFT JOIN paid p ON p.claim_id = c.claim_id LEFT JOIN os o ON o.claim_id = c.claim_id) SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(incurred),0) AS amount_affected FROM inc WHERE incurred >= 25000
defects.intended_behaviour: CR-0912 drops claims closed more than 90 days ago. A claim closed exactly 90 days ago should stay on the list (closed_date >= @PriorDate).
defects.title: Claims closed exactly 90 days ago are dropped

defects.description: Line 59 compares the untrimmed c.status with 'CLOSED'. SQL Server ignores trailing spaces and, under the usual collation, case, but it does not ignore leading spaces. A status such as ' CLOSED' passes the <> 'CLOSED' test, so claims closed long ago (or with no closed_date) still make the list. They then appear as 'CLOSED' because the output column is trimmed (INC-3204).
defects.impact_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS rows_affected, COALESCE(SUM(incurred_amount),0) AS amount_affected FROM golden_rpt_large_loss_watchlist WHERE claim_status = 'CLOSED' AND (closed_date IS NULL OR closed_date <= DATE'2025-10-02')
defects.intended_behaviour: Use the same cleaned status in the filter as in the output: UPPER(LTRIM(RTRIM(c.status))) <> 'CLOSED'. Closed claims would then stay only if closed_date > @PriorDate.
defects.title: CLOSED check uses the raw status, not the trimmed one
